items.title: 2.9 Ions aur free radicals ki electronic configuration (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.9, printed page 40.

blocks.text: Atoms electrons kho kar ya le kar ions bante hain, aur kuch species mein unpaired (akele, bina jore ke) electrons hote hain. In sab ki configuration atom ki configuration se nikalti hai. Agle do topics ions aur free radicals ko dekhte hain.

blocks.prompt: Aage parhne se pehle atoms ki configuration se Mg²⁺ aur F⁻ ki configuration ka andaza lagayein.
blocks.explanation: Magnesium 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s² hai; do 3s electrons kho kar Mg²⁺ = 1s² 2s² 2p⁶. Fluorine 1s² 2s² 2p⁵ hai; ek electron le kar F⁻ = 1s² 2s² 2p⁶. Dono ki configuration neon jaisi hai.

items: Positive ion: electrons nikaalein; negative ion: electrons jorein; free radical: unpaired electron dhoondein.
